verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents an optional strict publishing workflow that requires a separate Approver's sign-off before a policy is published. It also claims automation for creating, reviewing and acknowledging published policies, which covers approvals and implies employee acknowledgment. Missing for 10: any evidence of a lawyer-grade policy template library, a documented policy editor, explicit policy versioning, per-employee acceptance tracking or reporting beyond a one-line 'acknowledge' claim, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
